question: Can the advised rational-credit scheduler consume actual resumable checked finite refutations, preserve source applicability across requests, and satisfy both robust and advised-bank bounds while charging failed and unfinished work?
budget: 24 seeded request streams; 9 fixed proof procedures over 4 tiny CNF cores; epsilon 1, 1/2, 1/4; six advice banks including a labelled hindsight ideal; one run after source hash; preserve failures and version any repair.
inputs: Horizons 8,32,128; each request asks for zero, one or two UNSAT contexts drawn from fixed cores with optional tautological additions; prices 1/3,1,4,16; one deliberately invalid proof procedure; satisfiable core procedures terminate without a proof.
controls: Fallback only; independent per-request search; shared uniform ordinary schedule; exact hindsight bank under the same proof procedures. Identical ordinary advised scheduling ties by construction.
measurements: Named producer/checker/termination ticks, failed/unfinished ticks, fallback tariff, exact offline bill, advice bill, controller membership/credit/event counts, runtime separately.
pre_execution_review: Source parsed; manual interface, cap/rate, source-inclusion and terminal-failure review complete. No inputs or procedure completion costs executed before freeze.
